title: Undock fix: a docked ship has no way to take off
description: BUG (owner-reported): when the ship is DOCKED (at a landing pad or the home dock), there is no way to undock — no flight input ever takes the ship off. Expected behaviour (per design, see the server comment at shard.ts ~line 1888 'first input = take-off'): the server freezes a docked ship and its FIRST control demand launches it. Repro: dock the ship (the e2e flow in tests/e2e/docked-indicator.spec.ts lands a ship at the station pad; the starter scout spawns docked at the home dock with no padId), then press and hold W (thrust) or any flight control. Actual: the ship stays docked forever; the DOCKED indicator (tests/e2e/docked-indicator.spec.ts) never clears and the ship never moves. Suspected areas (starting points, not conclusions — trace where the first input frame is lost before fixing): (a) the client flight-loop dock gate in src/client/main.tsx ~line 1640-1674 (the `docked`/`nonzero` gate around `inputSender.shouldSend`, built for TASK-78 so idle frames never undock the server ship — it must keep suppressing idle frames but clearly drops the first REAL input too); (b) the seq counter in src/client/input/flight-loop.ts (a frame is due only on key change or the 20 Hz held cadence — check what the last-sent key is after docking); (c) src/client/state/docked.ts (wire-docked state source, driven from the entity_update handler in main.tsx ~line 463 — check the state is what you think it is at the moment of the first key press); (d) the server undock condition in src/server/shard/shard.ts ~line 1877-1908 (verify a real demand frame actually clears `entity.docked`). Fix the actual root cause; keep the TASK-78 invariant that NO idle (zero-demand) frames are sent while docked, or idle frames will launch the ship and expose it to rogue AI.

steps.details: Reproduce in the e2e browser (claim a callsign, dock at the station pad as in docked-indicator.spec.ts, hold W, observe the wire regime via window.__SELF_SHIP__ probes or entity_update). Instrument or read the code path client input → `inputSender.shouldSend` (src/client/input/flight-loop.ts) → `send('input', ...)` → server tick (src/server/shard/shard.ts ~1877-1908) and pin down exactly where the first real demand frame is dropped or where the server fails to clear `docked`. Write a failing unit test that encodes the contract: with the flight loop docked (wire-docked true), a zero-demand frame is suppressed, but the first non-zero demand frame IS sent with a fresh seq. The test must FAIL before the fix.

Implement the minimal fix at the identified root cause so that: (1) while wire-docked, idle/zero-demand frames remain suppressed (TASK-78 invariant — add a unit test asserting a zero-demand frame while docked sends NOTHING); (2) the first non-zero demand frame is sent and the server clears `entity.docked` within one tick; (3) after undock the normal flight input flow resumes with no seq gap/duplicate problems. Do not redesign the docked state plumbing (src/client/state/docked.ts) — it is used by the HUD, guidance and the flight gate.

steps.description: E2E regression: dock then fly off
steps.details: New spec tests/e2e/undock.spec.ts (reuse the fixtures and claim flow from docked-indicator.spec.ts): (a) land/dock at the station pad (or use the home-dock starter spawn) and assert the DOCKED indicator is visible; (b) assert the ship is frozen while idle (position unchanged for ~2 s of no input — the TASK-78 invariant on the wire); (c) press and hold W and assert within ~2 s the wire regime is no longer 'docked' AND the ship's position is changing (probe via window.__SELF_SHIP__); (d) assert the DOCKED indicator cleared. Save .ralph/screenshots/TASK-86-1.png mid-flight, off the pad. Look at it: the ship must be in the air, not on the pad.

cd app && npx tsc --noEmit; full npm run test; e2e: the new undock.spec.ts plus docked-indicator.spec.ts, disembark.spec.ts, enter-ship.spec.ts, flight.spec.ts, core-flow.spec.ts via npx playwright test --config playwright.e2e.config.ts <files>; eslint --fix + prettier --write on touched files. Commit fix(TASK-86): ...

acceptanceCriteria: A docked ship takes off on its first real flight input: e2e undock.spec.ts shows wire regime leaves 'docked' and the ship moves within ~2 s of pressing W
While docked and idle, no input frames reach the server (unit test: zero-demand frame while wire-docked sends nothing) — the TASK-78 invariant is preserved
The new spec's pre-fix assertions fail on the unfixed build and pass after the fix
DOCKED indicator appears on dock and clears on take-off in the e2e
npx tsc --noEmit green; full npm run test green; listed e2e specs green; one commit
notes: Design intent (do not break): docked server ship is frozen; FIRST input takes it off (shard.ts ~1888). The client dock gate exists so idle frames never launch the ship (TASK-78 close-out, main.tsx ~1630-1639).
The home-dock starter scout has regime 'docked' with NO padId — test BOTH the pad dock and the home dock.
The file/line hints above were gathered at planning time; the code has moved since TASK-82..85 — re-verify locations before editing.
Do NOT commit pre-existing dirty .ralph/screenshots/*.png mods.
